# Distribution register: copies and delivery charges

This register identifies the recipients of certified copies and the charges assigned to each delivery. The category labels appear inside the relevant cells as well as in the headings, so a copied row remains intelligible when read separately from the rest of the register.

| Recipient | Delivery details | Personal reference | Copies | Charge |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Person: ⟦PERSON|Vellin Asterne⟧ | Address: ⟦ADDRESS|16 Celandine Road, Ely⟧<br>Email: ⟦EMAIL|vellin.copies@aster-purl.invalid⟧ | Passport: ⟦IDENTITY|ZR5814267⟧ | 2 | GBP 32 |
| Person: ⟦PERSON|Orvessa Keldrick⟧ | Address: ⟦ADDRESS|43 Mallow Row, Ripon⟧<br>Email: ⟦EMAIL|orvessa.documents@keld-rill.invalid⟧ | Passport: ⟦IDENTITY|LP7426931⟧ | 3 | GBP 48 |
| Total | Five copies in two deliveries | No combined personal reference | 5 | GBP 80 |

The totals row describes the work and the aggregate charge. It does not identify an additional recipient. A delivery charge must not be reassigned merely to make the arithmetic match a payment already received.

The recipients must be notified if certification cannot be completed from the supplied originals. A later copy of a missing page must be checked before it is added to the certified set. The administrator should preserve the earlier index with an explanation of the addition.

The requested dispatch date is 29 December 2026. Paragraph 6.5 governs the certification sequence and the final check of the delivery labels.
